variations.name: Maledon and Wright in, Bartzokas coach
variations.tagline: Tuesday: Robinson, Jackson and Wright start cheap; Wednesday: Maledon, Vezenkov (C) and Kamenjas, with Feliz the strong Wednesday bench upgrade. Coach Bartzokas (OLY).

trades.why: Nunn is at Valencia (PAN 35% to win); Maledon is home to Zalgiris (70%) with Campazzo out indefinitely, 25.7 PIR over his last 3. [dom: ACB 15 Nov at Baskonia 16' PIR 29, acb.com]
Funds the chain. Jackson starts for an ASVEL missing Mills, Crowder and Bolomboy: 12.3 PIR in 19' and a cheap Tuesday starter. [dom: unverified after 2 searches]

Diarra is at Zvezda (Virtus 24% to win, 17.6' off the bench); Wright is Milan's only real big with Booker out, 36 PIR on Thursday, and ASVEL's frontcourt is thin. [dom: unverified after 2 searches; 8 Nov benched for lateness, eurohoops.net]
Olympiacos at home to Hapoel: 81% on the site model, the biggest favourite of the round, and it stacks with captain Vezenkov. Laso's Efes go to Baskonia at 63%.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov at home to Hapoel on Wednesday: 31.7 PIR over his last 3, and with Montero (6 months), Milutinov (finger) and Konchar (left the club) gone, Olympiacos run everything through him.
variations.captain_plan: Vezenkov has the armband all round; nobody on Tuesday is a better captain bet. After Tuesday: Jackson under 16 → Feliz in; Wright under 8 → Marinković in.
reasoning: About 28% for 200, against 15% with no trades: the best balanced plan the optimiser found.
Nights split 5/5: cheaper Tuesday starters (Robinson, Jackson, Wright), and Feliz (home to Zalgiris, 27' a game with Campazzo out) waits on Wednesday's bench as the upgrade.
Coach lens: Wright and Jackson play each other on Tuesday, but Wright is only the 6th man and Jackson can be swapped out for Feliz, so the clash costs little.
Correlation: Bartzokas (OLY) plus captain Vezenkov boom together if Olympiacos blow Hapoel out; Maledon and Feliz share Madrid's likely win.
Cheap upside watch: Jackson is the pick (cheapest real starter on Tuesday); Ward and Ndiaye (Konchar gone) were close but cost 4 credits more.
Unlimited window: these 4 moves cost nothing, and they keep Robinson, Kamenjas and Vezenkov, the core for R15–R16.
cancel_if: If Maledon is limited after tonight at Olympiacos (knee), keep Nunn and buy Hifi with the Malcolm money instead.
If Wright is benched again or misses Tuesday, keep Diarra.
If Vezenkov picks up a knock tonight, captain Maledon and swap the coach to Martinez (MAD).

variations.name: Keep Diarra, Abalde for Rogkavopoulos
variations.tagline: Same core as A, but Diarra stays as 6th man and the dead-weight Rogkavopoulos becomes Abalde, a Wednesday bench option.

trades.why: As in A: Madrid at home (70%) beats PAN at Valencia (35%). [dom: ACB 15 Nov at Baskonia 16' PIR 29, acb.com]
Cheap Tuesday starter with a real role at a thin ASVEL. [dom: unverified after 2 searches]
Rogkavopoulos plays 8' in the EuroLeague; Abalde starts for a depleted Madrid (22.5' over his last 3) and gives a second Wednesday bench option. [dom: ACB 15 Nov at Baskonia, acb.com box score]
The round's biggest favourite (81%), stacked with captain Vezenkov.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov at home to Hapoel, as in A. He is the captain almost every manager will pick, which is what you want when protecting rank.
reasoning: About 28% for 200, level with A, with less risk: Diarra's 9/10 rounds at or above his price stays.
Diarra is a template center; keeping him limits rank damage if Virtus keep it close at Zvezda.
Rogkavopoulos is the clear dead weight (8' in the EuroLeague), so a trade on him is free value in an unlimited window.
After Tuesday: Jackson under 16 → Feliz; Diarra under 9 → Abalde; Robinson under 8 → Marinković.
Cheap upside watch: Jackson again; Abalde is the Wednesday bench version of the same idea.
cancel_if: If Abalde's minutes drop with Ndiaye debuting for Madrid, take Procida (5.0) instead.
If Maledon is limited after tonight, keep Nunn.

variations.name: Hifi captain on Tuesday, Navarro coach
variations.tagline: Moonshot: Hifi (C) at Besiktas in the first game of the round, Wright inside, coach Navarro (RED); the armband moves to Vezenkov on Wednesday if Hifi is quiet.

trades.why: Paris have won six straight and Hifi is their engine (20 PIR a game, 18 pts vs Hapoel on Thursday); Besiktas–Paris is a 92–91 shoot-out on the model. [dom: LNB unverified after 2 searches]
Funds Hifi; Jackson starts for a depleted ASVEL. [dom: unverified after 2 searches]
Higher ceiling (36 PIR on Thursday) and no longer up against coach Navarro's Zvezda. [dom: unverified after 2 searches]
Zvezda at home to Virtus: 73.5% and +7 on the model, the best value coach of the round, and only possible once Diarra is sold.

variations.captain_note: Hifi at Besiktas is a low-owned captain with a 35+ ceiling in a fast game. If he scores under about 28, move the armband to Vezenkov on Wednesday.
variations.captain_plan: Hifi (C) on Tuesday; if he scores under 28, move the armband to Vezenkov (unplayed starter) on Wednesday. Da Silva under 14 → Feliz in.
reasoning: About 1 in 4 for 200 on the model, but the fatter right tail: two shots at a 30+ captain (Hifi, then Vezenkov).
Hifi is the only guard with a real 35+ ceiling who plays Tuesday, which is what makes the armband switch work.
Coach lens: Besiktas without Nowell are weak on the perimeter; Paris play fast.
Navarro (RED) is cheap and clear (+7 on the model), and selling Diarra removes the clash.
Higher variance than A: Hifi is 2.9 more expensive than Maledon and plays away.
cancel_if: If Hifi is listed doubtful on Monday, play A.
If Zvezda's Motley and Moneke are both still out, switch the coach to Bartzokas (OLY) using the bank.

rumours.text: John Konchar left the club on 16 Nov for personal reasons, two weeks after signing. Montero is out for six months (knee surgery), Milutinov misses a third game (finger), Dorsey is still off the roster.
rumours.impact: More usage and minutes for Vezenkov (39.5' on Tuesday) and Fournier; Ward and Ndiaye get Konchar's forward minutes. Bartzokas (OLY) stays a strong coach pick at home.

rumours.text: Mike James is out for 7–9 months (Achilles surgery); Bruno Fernando is out 3–4 weeks (calf).
rumours.impact: Efes are thin inside: good for Kamenjas at home to them on Wednesday; Malcolm keeps big minutes but Efes are only 63% at Baskonia.

rumours.text: Campazzo (hamstring) is out indefinitely; Jantunen (plantar fascia) and Deck (shoulder) are also out. Eli Ndiaye is registered and could debut.
rumours.impact: Maledon and Feliz both play 24–27 minutes: buy Maledon, keep Feliz. Abalde and Procida start in the forward spots.

rumours.text: Punter (ankle) is out until late December, Evbuomwan until early December, Gibson for three weeks; Killian Hayes has signed.
rumours.impact: Robinson keeps a starting role at home to Fenerbahce; Hayes will take some of it from R14 on.

rumours.text: Dzanan Musa took an elbow to the eye at Maccabi on Thursday and finished on the bench with his eye covered.
rumours.impact: If he misses Wednesday, Bacon and Okobo get more shots. No Dubai player in your plans.

players.name: Sasha Vezenkov

players.name: Kenan Kamenjas
players.read: 25 PIR at Bayern (16 pts, 13 reb, 30'), after 19 on his debut. Starting center while Faried and Santos are out; Efes come to Vitoria without Fernando. The site's 18.1 looks right; 5.4 credits is the best value in the game. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Real Madrid 24' PIR 22, acb.com]

players.name: Justin Robinson
players.read: Plays tonight vs Zvezda; 17–23 PIR in four of his last five, all starts. Punter and Gibson are out, but Hayes has signed, so expect 22–24' rather than 27. Home to Fenerbahce on Tuesday. [dom: ACB 15 Nov vs Obradoiro 15' PIR 9, acb.com]

window_plan: The rebuild's best plan sells Nunn, Robinson, Malcolm, Rogkavopoulos and Da Silva for Hifi, Maledon, Edwin Jackson, Abalde and Frisch with coach Bartzokas (OLY): about 18.6% a round over R14–R16, but it gives up Robinson and Da Silva, who are fine. I'd make Variation A's 4 moves and add Rogkavopoulos → Abalde (free in the window), keeping Robinson until Hayes's role is clear. Nothing needs buying before Saturday: prices move after tonight, so check Maledon's and Wright's new prices first.
